notebooks.contract: assert h.subs({x:1,y:1})==7; assert sp.diff(h,x)==-2*x and sp.diff(h,y)==-4*y; assert h.subs({x:sp.Rational(11,10),y:1})==sp.Rational(679,100); assert sp.limit(F.subs(y,0),x,0)==0; assert sp.limit(F.subs(y,x),x,0)==sp.Rational(1,2)

notebooks.title: 核对局部估计与方向导数
notebooks.contract: assert g==sp.Matrix([-2,-4]); assert predicted==sp.Rational(36,5) and actual==sp.Rational(717,100); assert actual-predicted==-sp.Rational(3,100); assert g.dot(d)==-sp.Rational(22,5); assert g.norm()==2*sp.sqrt(5); assert sp.simplify(g/g.norm()-sp.Matrix([-1,-2])/sp.sqrt(5))==sp.zeros(2,1); assert g.dot(tangent)==0

notebooks.title: 核对路径链式法则与雅可比
notebooks.contract: assert sp.simplify(direct-chain)==0; assert direct.subs(t,sp.pi/4)==-1; assert J==sp.Matrix([[-2,-4],[1,1]]); assert J*shift==sp.Matrix([-sp.Rational(1,5),sp.Rational(1,10)]); assert actual==sp.Matrix([-sp.Rational(21,100),sp.Rational(1,10)])

notebooks.title: 核对二阶近似与驻点边界
notebooks.contract: assert H==sp.diag(-2,-4) and H.det()==8; assert (d.T*H*d)[0]/2==-dx**2-2*dy**2; assert sp.hessian(x*x-y*y,(x,y)).det()==-4; assert sp.hessian(x**4+y**4,(x,y)).subs({x:0,y:0})==sp.zeros(2)

notebooks.title: 核对面积积分与中点近似
notebooks.contract: assert sp.integrate(h,(y,0,1),(x,0,1))==9; assert total==sp.Rational(3601,400); assert sum(h.subs({x:sp.Rational(2*i+1,4),y:sp.Rational(2*j+1,4)}) for i in range(2) for j in range(2))/4==sp.Rational(145,16)

notebooks.title: 复核六题步骤答案
notebooks.contract: assert pred==sp.Rational(36,5); assert actual==sp.Rational(717,100); assert g.dot(sp.Matrix([3,4])/5)==-sp.Rational(22,5); assert J==sp.Matrix([[-2,-4],[1,1]]); assert heights==[sp.Rational(157,16),sp.Rational(141,16),sp.Rational(149,16),sp.Rational(133,16)]; assert sum(heights)/4==sp.Rational(145,16); assert sum(heights)/4-9==sp.Rational(1,16)
